label: Town of Colchester
header:
# Town of Colchester municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 6; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists five Colchester Selectboard members: Maureen Dakin, Pam Loranger, Jacki Murphy, Charlie Papillo, and Paul Pecor.
Town of Colchester official website, Selectboard page: lists 'Pam Loranger, Chair', 'Charlie Papillo, Vice Chair', 'Jacki Murphy, Clerk', 'Maureen Dakin', and 'Paul Pecor' -- the same five.

Colchester town charter, 24 Appendix V.S.A. chapter 113, section 202 (official text): provides for the election of a Moderator at the annual meeting. Structure only: no official source read publishes the current holder; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.

Colchester town charter, 24 Appendix V.S.A. chapter 113, section 202 (official text): the Town Clerk is not an elected officer under the charter; under section 404(k) the Town Manager appoints the Town Clerk (a 2018 charter amendment, Act M-17, converted the office from elected to appointed).
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Julie Graeter as Town Clerk of Colchester.
Town of Colchester official website, staff directory: Julie Graeter serves as Town Clerk/Treasurer. The holder is recorded as appointed.

Colchester town charter, 24 Appendix V.S.A. chapter 113, section 202 (official text): the Town Treasurer is not an elected officer under the charter; under section 404(k) the Town Manager appoints the Town Treasurer (a 2018 charter amendment, Act M-17, converted the office from elected to appointed).
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Julie Graeter as Town Treasurer of Colchester.
Town of Colchester official website, staff directory: Julie Graeter serves as Town Clerk/Treasurer. The holder is recorded as appointed.

Colchester town charter, 24 Appendix V.S.A. chapter 113, section 202 (official text): provides for the election of one Lister each year to a 3-year term (a board of three); the elected listers sit as the Board of Assessment under section 501.

Town of Colchester official website, Boards & Commissions page, lists the listers among the town's elected boards. The three listers' own signed statutory notice of June 12, 2026 (32 V.S.A. section 4111, published in Seven Days legal notices) is signed by Geri Barrows, Charlotte Gardner, and Angela MacDonald.
Colchester town charter, 24 Appendix V.S.A. chapter 113, section 202 (official text): provides for the election of one Library Trustee each year to a 5-year term (a board of five).
Town of Colchester official website, Burnham Memorial Library Board of Trustees page: lists Toni Josey (Chair), Leora Black, Carol Anderson, Rebecca McMahon, and Brent Litterer.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists fifteen Colchester justices of the peace: Carol Anderson, Sarita Austin, Leora Black, Ruth Blauwiekel, Mary Brennan, Patrick Brennan, Wendy Critchlow, Maureen Dakin, Peg Gillard, Julie Hulburd, Marie-Reine Pepin, Curt Taylor, Tom Yasewicz, Jeanette Berry, and Robby Mazza.

jp_election.name: Town of Colchester Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists fifteen Colchester justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024: Carol Anderson, Sarita Austin, Leora Black, Ruth Blauwiekel, Mary Brennan, Patrick Brennan, Wendy Critchlow, Maureen Dakin, Peg Gillard, Julie Hulburd, Marie-Reine Pepin, Curt Taylor, Tom Yasewicz, Jeanette Berry, and Robby Mazza. The listing publishes no vote totals or party labels and none are recorded. Sarita Austin and Wendy Critchlow are the sitting State Representatives for the Chittenden-19 district (Colchester); their existing person records carry this candidacy.
